profile.heroLede: I turn everyday observations into useful systems, considered design and photographs worth pausing for.
profile.aboutIntro: My work moves between people, systems and visual stories. Running a busy outlet taught me to notice what gets in the way. Design taught me to make things clearer. Building products gave me a way to connect the two.
profile.aboutCardBody: Whether I am mapping an ordering workflow or waiting for light on a quiet street, I start by paying attention.

projects.title: TFC Orders Tracker
projects.description: Turning orders, production and stock into a shared operational picture.

projects.description: Attendance, fees and student records, with corrections that leave a trace.

projects.title: Second Brain
projects.description: An Android-first knowledge workspace built around a portable local vault.

projects.title: Banu 2.0
projects.description: A personal voice assistant connecting conversation with explicitly defined tools.

projects.title: VELORIA
projects.description: A shared brand architecture for photography, stories, learning and digital products.
